'''Hov Windell''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] assigned to recover a modulator for a [[hyperwave signal interceptor]] from an abandoned [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rentalles/Legends|Rentalles]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
